# Hibiki 21 Years Old

The epitome of blossoming elegance, our [Hibiki whisky range](https://house.suntory.com/hibiki-whisky) celebrates an unrivaled art of blending, fine craftsmanship and a sense of luxury from the House of Suntory.

Hibiki 21 is defined by a remarkable blending of **Japanese malt and grain whiskies**, aged for at least 21 years. Harmonious flavors unfold on the palate, with a rich incense finish. Without a doubt, the quintessence of **blended Japanese whisky**.

43% ABV · 70cl

## A prized Japanese whisky

The Hibiki 21 Years Old is handcrafted by The House of Suntory with the nature and spirit of Japan in mind. The bottle is shaped like a prism with 24 facets, each representing a season of the traditional Japanese calendar.

A prestigious blend that unites the single malts from the Yamazaki and Hakushu Distilleries with smooth grain whiskies from Chita Distillery is aged for a minimum 21 years in American bourbon oak casks and European sherry casks, culminating in the special marriage of Japanese Mizunara oak. An elegant and sophisticated expression showcasing the essence of Suntory's blending artistry.

### Frequently Asked Questions

## \#\#\# Where is Hibiki 21 made?

Every stage, from distillation to bottling, takes place entirely in Japan. Hibiki 21 is crafted by blending exceptional single malts from **the Yamazaki and Hakushu distilleries with smooth grain whiskies from the Chita distillery,** where they are aged for at least 21 years before being masterfully assembled and bottled.

## \#\#\# How should a Hibiki 21 bottle be stored?

**A Hibiki 21 bottle should stand upright, stay in its original box and rest somewhere cool and unchanging**. Upright, because the whisky's strength would work against the seal over time. Boxed, because light draws out color and aroma slowly enough to go unnoticed. Cool and steady, because sudden change matters more than warmth.

## \#\#\# What sets Hibiki 21 apart within the Hibiki range?

As **one of the oldest age statements in the range**, Hibiki 21 is the most awarded expression from the House of Suntory. Repeatedly recognized as the World's Best Blended Whisky, it is globally revered as a definitive pinnacle of **Japanese blending artistry**.

## \#\#\# How is Hibiki 21 different from Hibiki Japanese Harmony?

**Both come from the same three distilleries and the same hand.** Harmony is composed for brightness and balance, blending whiskies of many ages. Hibiki 21 Years Old draws only on casks matured over 21 years, where time deepens the blend into something slower and more layered.

## \#\#\# Why is Hibiki 21 Years Old so rare?

**Because this Japanese whisky was laid down twenty-one years ago**, and no amount of demand can change that. Our Chief Blender draws only on the casks that have matured into what Hibiki asks of them, a small number, chosen from among many. What reaches the world is limited by patience, not by intention.
